summary: Screening identified 6 potential gap(s) across 6 governance areas.

findings.title: Privacy notice and personal data handling
findings.recommendation: Document what personal data is collected, why it is used, the applicable lawful basis or consent, and user rights.

findings.title: Data security controls
findings.recommendation: Specify encryption, access controls, authentication, secure storage, and incident response procedures.

findings.title: Transparency and explainability
findings.recommendation: Explain when AI is used, its intended purpose, important limitations, and how decisions can be challenged.

findings.title: Human oversight and escalation
findings.recommendation: Define when a qualified person reviews outputs, overrides decisions, and handles appeals or escalations.

findings.title: Data retention and deletion
findings.recommendation: Set retention periods, deletion procedures, and rules for backups and third-party processors.

findings.title: Bias and fairness evaluation
findings.recommendation: Describe representative testing data, subgroup performance evaluation, bias monitoring, and mitigation.

disclaimer: Heuristic screening only. A missing keyword does not prove a control is absent, and a matching keyword does not prove a control is effective. Human review is required.
